scientific_integrity: All-index proof uses previously published Lucas and Motzkin-trinomial identities. A standalone integer and finite-state checker supports but does not replace the proof. Prior art is distinguished by mathematical implication comparisons; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Ratio defined only for odd primes with all first p central trinomial digits nonzero; explicit block histogram is modulo thirteen only, not thirteen powers. No optimal logarithmic discrepancy or unique-priority assertion.
title: A forbidden Motzkin–trinomial ratio modulo thirteen and exact laws at zero-free primes
